subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-07-31
html:
Week 8 Pulse

Shipped since last pulse (2026-07-24): /compare/funnel-vs-arlo (2026-07-27, closes the comparison hub against the audit's full named-competitor list) plus a pricing-accuracy fix on 2 comparison pages that same session, and a second pricing-accuracy fix on 2 persona pages (/services/solo-business-owner, /services/agency-owner) on 2026-07-30, which also surfaced a routing finding (a dormant, unused route.ts scaffold sitting next to the live persona template — flagged in the worklog for a human decision, not yet acted on). Below is where the numbers stand — several rows are still pending because the automated GSC/GA4 data pulls aren't wired into this sandbox yet.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending — GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing, but this sandbox has no outbound GA4 API access. Still waiting on the scheduled data Action (12-week-strategy.md Week 8) to backfill this row.

Ranking movement

KeywordLast wkNowTrend
No rank data — see "Anything broken?" below

Since actual SERP position isn't trackable yet, here's the closest available signal — US search-demand movement (not rank) on the wedge terms, month-over-month per SE Ranking's own trend data, re-pulled live this session: google ads mcp 390→590/mo, google analytics mcp 320→390/mo, claude mcp server 735→810/mo, mcp connector 170→210/mo (the page this domain's own blog post targets) — all four still climbing, none softening. supermetrics alternative ticked down slightly (210→170/mo, still KD 16, still $33.76 CPC). This is demand, not ARLO's share of it — with no rank tracking wired up, we still can't say whether any of the 7 connector/compare pages targeting these terms are gaining ground.

Traffic vs last week

Pending — same root cause as rankings: no SE Ranking tracking project for askarlo.app. Re-checked SE Ranking's own organic index live this session (getDomainOverviewByCountry, US) — still zero indexed organic/paid keywords for askarlo.app, and getAiSearchOverview still shows null brand_presence, 0 link_presence, 0 ai_opportunity_traffic. Same reading as every prior pulse.

Anything broken?

No build/pipeline regressions. SEO Report Email Action: 13 of 14 runs green since 2026-07-04 (the one failure was the very first shakeout run, before the pipeline worked end-to-end); every run since — including both shipping sessions since the last pulse (2026-07-27, 2026-07-30) — sent and archived cleanly. Both sessions logged a clean npm run build + npm run lint per the worklog. Only two workflows exist in this repo (Keepalive, SEO Report Email) — there's no separate CI build gate in Actions, so the per-session manual build/lint check in the worklog is still the only build verification happening.

Still open: the SE Ranking rank-tracking gap, now on its 4th consecutive weekly pulse (flagged 2026-07-10, 2026-07-17, 2026-07-24, and again today) with no change. Re-confirmed this session — still no SE Ranking project for askarlo.app among the 36 other client sites this account tracks. Two more pages shipped since the last pulse with zero rank visibility into either — that's now 9 pages/posts total since this gap was first flagged, still with no way to tell whether any of them are actually moving in search.

catalog.ts drift is now hitting its own stated deadlines. Re-checked src/lib/connectors/catalog.ts this session: meta_ads still coming_soon with eta "May 2026" (3 months past due), tiktok_ads still coming_soon with eta "June 2026" (1 month past due), and hubspot/mailerlite are both marked eta "July 2026" — the current month, expiring today with no status flip. This is the same human-decision blocker flagged in the worklog since 2026-07-20 (now open across 6 content sessions) — none of these 9 connectors can get a public marketing page until a human confirms real launch status and flips the catalog.

Reading the week

Content-wise this was a cleanup week rather than a new-page week — both sessions found and fixed the same class of bug (stale pre-early-access pricing) on already-indexed pages instead of shipping new ones, which is the right call for trust on live pages but means no new keyword surface area was added since 2026-07-27's Funnel.io page. The comparison hub is now fully caught up to the audit's named-competitor list, so the two structural blockers carrying over week to week are unchanged: rank visibility (SE Ranking project, unset for 3+ weeks of pulses) and the catalog.ts connector-status decision (now past its own stated dates on 2 of 9 connectors). Both need a human, not another content session.
